link.01e8e548013f.source: CrewAI, LangChain, and LangGraph all expose this same factory under names that vary by framework, whether Agent or create_agent or a role/goal dataclass. The cell below builds two specialists from the same four parameters, an arithmetic tutor and a translator that both run on one input with their replies rendered side by side.
link.01e8e548013f.value: CrewAI、 LangChain 和 LangGraph 都以各框架特有的名称提供了同一种工厂，无论其名称是Agent、create_agent，还是角色/目标 dataclass。以下单元使用相同的四个参数构建两个专用智能体：一个算术辅导智能体和一个翻译智能体。两者处理同一个输入，回复并排呈现。

link.088977681e2f.source: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations (2023). The planner / worker / solver decomposition this module's Workflow Agent implements.
link.088977681e2f.value: Xu et al., ReWOO: Decoupling Reasoning from Observations (2023)。本模块的工作流智能体采用了 planner / worker / solver 分解方式。

link.139eba09e8b7.source:
At each step the model reads the latest observation before it picks an action and runs a tool, then sizes up whatever came back and chooses again. The agent reacts to whatever the previous tool call returned, so the path through the tools takes shape as it runs. That makes ReAct strong when the path depends on intermediate results and weak when many steps could have run at once.

Paper: Yao et al., 2022.
link.139eba09e8b7.value:
在每一步中，模型都会先读取最新观察结果，再选择行动并运行工具；随后评估返回结果，再次作出选择。智能体会对上一次工具调用的返回结果作出响应，因此工具使用路径是在运行过程中逐步形成的。当执行路径取决于中间结果时，ReAct 表现出色；而当多个步骤本可同时运行时，它的表现则较弱。

论文：Yao et al., 2022。

link.1be52ce4d6ee.source: Comprehensive list at Going Further · References.
link.1be52ce4d6ee.value: 完整列表请参阅深入探索 · 参考资料。

link.3358ef3956ff.source: Madaan et al., Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback (2023). The pattern behind iterative multi-pass research: an agent critiques its own output and re-runs until a quality threshold is met.
link.3358ef3956ff.value: Madaan et al., Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback (2023)。迭代式多轮研究背后的模式：智能体评判自己的输出并重新运行，直到达到质量阈值。

link.39f1ebc65c2a.source:
The model writes the full plan upfront in one LLM call before any tool runs at all. A deterministic executor then runs every tool that the plan named, often in parallel, and a second LLM call reads what came back to synthesize the results. Because the plan never sees a tool result, the model "reasons without observation." That makes ReWOO strong when the steps are independent and weak when later steps need to react to earlier ones.

Paper: Xu et al., 2023.
link.39f1ebc65c2a.value:
在任何工具开始运行之前，模型会通过一次 LLM 调用预先写出完整计划。随后，确定性执行器通常会并行运行计划中指定的所有工具，再由第二次 LLM 调用读取返回结果并进行综合。由于计划始终看不到工具结果，模型是在“无观察的情况下推理”。因此，当各步骤彼此独立时，ReWOO 表现出色；而当后续步骤需要根据前序结果作出响应时，它的表现则较弱。

论文：Xu et al., 2023。

link.4f07e539a6af.source: Wang et al., Plan-and-Solve Prompting (2023). The simpler ancestor: a single LLM call writes a plan, the same LLM executes step-by-step. ReWOO splits planner from executor.
link.4f07e539a6af.value: Wang et al., Plan-and-Solve Prompting (2023)。这是更简单的前身：一次 LLM 调用写出计划，同一个 LLM 逐步执行计划。ReWOO 将 planner 与执行器分离。

rich.242c5dc34093.source: Role. A short label, used for logs and routing.
rich.242c5dc34093.value: 角色。用于日志记录和路由的简短标签。

rich.50ba04ccb0aa.source: Context bloat is real. A single agent doing everything accumulates 10000-token context. Specialists stay focused on their slice.
rich.50ba04ccb0aa.value: 上下文膨胀确实存在。由单个智能体包办所有工作会累积 10000-token 上下文，而各个专用智能体可以专注于各自负责的部分。

rich.58a54f63f510.source: Parallelism is possible. Two workers run concurrently, where one agent could only run them in sequence. Three independent searches finish in the time of the slowest.
rich.58a54f63f510.value: 可以并行处理。两个工作单元可以并发运行，而单个智能体只能依次执行。三项独立搜索可在其中最慢一项所需的时间内全部完成。

rich.79e7f0a66de9.source: Specialization matters. Different workstreams need different system prompts, tools, or models. One agent forced into both roles degrades both.
rich.79e7f0a66de9.value: 专业分工很重要。不同工作流需要不同的系统提示词、工具或模型。强迫一个智能体同时承担两种角色，会使两方面的表现都下降。

rich.82b2c51d66a4.source: Promise.all is JavaScript's helper for starting several promises and waiting until all of them finish. Here it is just the concurrency mechanism: it does not call the model and it does not decide which searches to run.
rich.82b2c51d66a4.value: Promise.all 是 JavaScript 中用于启动多个 promise 并等待它们全部完成的辅助函数。在这里，它只负责实现并发：既不调用模型，也不决定要运行哪些搜索。

rich.8b10c8770bc6.source: The next two parts carry this composition idea forward. Part B (Indices) points the same idea at corpora rather than at other agents so that a knowledge layer becomes an agent wrapping a body of data behind a query interface. Part C (Deep Agents) takes it further still, into a planner agent that dispatches sub-agents in fresh contexts and persists their working state to a virtual filesystem.
rich.8b10c8770bc6.value: 接下来的两个部分将继续拓展这一组合思路。B 部分（索引）将同样的思路用于语料库，而非其它智能体，使知识层成为一个智能体，通过查询接口封装一组数据。C 部分（深度智能体）会进一步构建一个 planner 智能体，由它在全新上下文中调度子智能体，并将其工作状态持久化到虚拟文件系统。

rich.8b46273b0a2f.source: Synthesizer. A second LLM call reads every result and writes the brief, citing each search by index.
rich.8b46273b0a2f.value: 综合器。第二次 LLM 调用读取所有结果并撰写简报，同时按索引引用每项搜索。

rich.90cf8f19cd7a.source: The overhead tax in concrete terms. Every agent boundary adds model-call latency and routing logic. It also creates another source of malformed messages and replaces a readable timeline with a trajectory that fans across workers.
rich.90cf8f19cd7a.value: 开销具体体现在哪里。每个智能体边界都会增加模型调用延迟和路由逻辑，还会引入一个新的消息格式错误来源，并将清晰易读的时间线变成一条向多个工作单元分叉的执行轨迹。

rich.b485aaf225cf.source: Invoke contract. A consistent shape (specialist.run(input)) that returns the final reply.
rich.b485aaf225cf.value: 调用约定。采用统一形式（specialist.run(input)）并返回最终回复。

rich.b78f1a0b8a39.source: In practice, you can have both. Many real systems borrow from each approach at once. The tools a ReAct loop calls might internally run a planned, ReWOO-style pipeline, and a planner that lays its work out in advance still needs sub-agents to execute each step, which are usually ReAct loops in their own right. Compose these software components wherever their strengths fit, reserving a Workflow Agent for tasks that split into independent workstreams.
rich.b78f1a0b8a39.value: 在实践中，可以同时采用两者。许多实际系统会同时借鉴这两种方法。ReAct 循环所调用的工具可能会在内部运行预先规划的 ReWOO 式工作流；而通过 planner 预先安排工作的系统仍需要子智能体执行各个步骤，这些子智能体本身通常也是 ReAct 循环。请根据各自优势组合这些软件组件，并将工作流智能体用于可拆分为独立工作流的任务。

rich.d728bd0d5ae9.source: Executor. Plain JavaScript. Every query runs concurrently via Promise.all, with no LLM calls at this stage.
rich.d728bd0d5ae9.value: 执行器。使用纯 JavaScript。每个查询都通过 Promise.all 并发运行，此阶段不进行 LLM 调用。

rich.dcde6ae021af.source: Failure isolation helps. A crashed worker does not kill the whole task. The orchestrator retries, skips, or routes around it.
rich.dcde6ae021af.value: 故障隔离很有帮助。某个工作单元崩溃不会导致整个任务失败。编排器可以重试、跳过它或选择其它路由。

rich.dfb993bf67b0.source: System prompt. The behaviour contract: what it does, what it refuses, and how it phrases its replies.
rich.dfb993bf67b0.value: 系统提示词。行为约定：它要做什么、拒绝做什么，以及如何组织回复。

rich.e3bb4592aaee.source: Compare one support incident. For “I was charged twice for the same subscription,” a single ReAct loop reads each lookup result before choosing its next action. A structured workflow can route billing verification and account-history checks into independent branches, then combine their evidence. Use the loop when the next step depends on the latest observation. Use the workflow when the branches and their join are known before execution.
rich.e3bb4592aaee.value: 对比同一个支持事件的处理方式。对于“同一订阅被重复扣费”这一问题，单个 ReAct 循环会先读取每次查询的结果，再选择下一步操作。结构化工作流可以将账单核验和账户历史记录检查路由到相互独立的分支，然后汇总各分支的证据。如果下一步取决于最新的观察结果，请使用循环。如果在执行前就已明确各个分支及其汇合方式，请使用工作流。

rich.e622373c2f66.source: Routing is a different shape of multi-agent in which a triage agent classifies the input and hands it to one specialist. Because the classifier must emit one of a fixed enum of categories, the output needs a tight contract. A fixed enum is a closed list of allowed labels; if the model returns anything else, the router should reject the route or retry under stricter instructions instead of guessing. Each specialist downstream owns a narrow system prompt and does not need to see the triage agent's reasoning.
rich.e622373c2f66.value: 路由是多智能体的另一种组织方式：分流智能体对输入进行分类，再将其交给一个专用智能体。由于分类器必须输出固定枚举中的一个类别，因此输出需要遵循严格的约定。固定枚举是一个封闭的允许标签列表；如果模型返回其它任何值，路由都应拒绝该结果或在更严格的指令下重试，而不能自行猜测。下游每个专用智能体都有范围明确的系统提示词，无需查看分流智能体的推理过程。

rich.ee9574e0b7d0.source: Planner. One schema-bound LLM call emits a JSON list of 3-5 search queries.
rich.ee9574e0b7d0.value: Planner。一次受 schema 约束的 LLM 调用会生成包含 3 至 5 个搜索查询的 JSON 列表。

rich.f27440ffd362.source: A single ReAct loop handles most one-shot tasks, but harder problems sometimes need structure that decides work before the next tool result arrives. A workflow agent means an agent system where your harness controls a workflow: a graph of model calls, deterministic code steps, tool calls, and specialist loops. This shape helps when sub-tasks that run in parallel can share results, when a plan can be written before tools run, or when routing should follow a rule instead of the last observation.
rich.f27440ffd362.value: 单个 ReAct 循环可以处理大多数一次性任务，但更困难的问题有时需要一种结构，在下一个工具结果返回之前就决定要执行的工作。工作流智能体是指由执行框架控制工作流的智能体系统：该工作流由模型调用、确定性代码步骤、工具调用和专家循环组成。以下情形适合采用这种结构：并行运行的子任务可以共享结果；可以在工具运行前制定计划；或者路由应遵循规则，而不是取决于最近一次观察结果。

text.5ff0f3bacd3b.source:
The harness can scope a workflow around a model call, a deterministic step,
      a specialist loop, or a group of parallel branches. At each boundary, it decides
      what context crosses, what can branch, and which results feed the next pipeline
      stage. Fan-out and fixed routing make that control visible without replacing the
      ReAct loop from the previous page.
text.5ff0f3bacd3b.value:
执行框架可以围绕一次模型调用、一个确定性步骤、一个专家循环或一组并行分支界定工作流范围。在每个边界处，执行框架都会决定哪些上下文可以跨越边界、哪些部分可以分支，以及哪些结果将传入工作流的下一阶段。扇出和固定路由让这种控制清晰可见，同时保留上一页介绍的
      ReAct 循环。

text.801d27873126.source:
That tax is fixed regardless of the task, so the question becomes whether the work
    returns enough to cover it. A linear job that one prompt already handles will never
    recoup the extra calls and the routing logic that they require. The split begins to
    earn its keep only once the task itself carries the kind of structure that a single
    loop has no choice but to flatten down into one timeline. Any one of the conditions
    below makes the trade pay off.
text.801d27873126.value: 无论任务是什么，这项开销都是固定的，因此关键在于工作收益能否覆盖它。对于一个提示词就能处理的线性任务，额外调用及其所需的路由逻辑永远无法收回成本。只有当任务本身具备某种结构，而单一循环只能被迫将其压缩为一条时间线时，拆分才开始体现价值。只要满足以下任一条件，这项权衡就值得。

text.bbca6d86a57e.source:
The ReWOO pipeline was parallel by construction, since every query it planned ran
    concurrently against the glossary. A more common parallel pattern fans one shared
    input out to several specialists that each carry their own system prompt and all run
    at once. In the trace, total wall time tracks the slowest specialist while the others
    overlap inside that window, the Gantt chart shows each specialist's duration, and all
    specialists share one web-search result so cost stays bounded.
text.bbca6d86a57e.value: ReWOO 工作流在设计上就是并行的，因为它规划的每个查询都会针对术语表并发运行。另一种更常见的并行模式是将一个共享输入分发给多个专用智能体；每个智能体都有自己的系统提示词，并且全部同时运行。在执行轨迹中，总耗时取决于最慢的专用智能体，其它智能体则在这段时间内重叠运行。甘特图会显示每个专用智能体的运行时长，并且所有智能体共享一项网络搜索结果，从而将成本控制在一定范围内。
